sentences.text: Parabuchanosteus is classified as a placoderm, an ancient group of armored fish.
The species was first described by White in 1952.

Originally known as Buchanosteus murrumbidgeensis, the species was moved to a new genus after a re-examination in 1972. This genus, Parabuchanosteus, was established that year and belongs to the family Parabuchanosteidae.
Fossils of this animal have been found in Late Emsian marine rocks in New South Wales, Australia, where it lived between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
